# DM Serif Display

- Family: DM Serif Display
- Source: Google Fonts, `ofl/dmserifdisplay`
- Published web build: version 17
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `OFL.txt`
- Bundled subsets: Latin and Latin Extended

The font is self-hosted and used only for traveler-authored trip names and booking titles. Interface text continues to use the native Apple/system stack.
